description: Start a new agent session on one of your person's computers: their host runs it as it runs a launch from their phone. Only what the person approved: a board card they answered, or else ask them first, one question on the Goal it is for naming the session, its role, model and mode; pass that question's questionId as approvalQuestionId. brief becomes the session's first Goal, under parentGoalId when given. Name a workspace the host granted or the repo. mode is bypass unless ask. A refusal says why. Returns sessionId, the agent, the brief's goalId and next.

approvalQuestionId.description: The questionId (the whole UUID) of the question you asked the person that names this session, once they answered it: a board card's, or one you ask first.

brief.description: The session's first Goal: what to do, one paragraph of at most 500 characters.

hostTokenId.description: The computer to run it on. Omitted: the live host that offers it.

mode.description: bypass (default): every tool call allowed. ask: each blocked action goes to the person's phone.

model.description: The model the card approved, passed to the harness.

name.description: The session's role name, as the person will see it.

parentGoalId.description: The Goal the brief goes under, such as the Team project.

repo.description: The repo the work is in (owner/name); the session opens in it.

workspace.description: A folder the host granted. Name it or repo.

name: launch
title: Launch a session
